observed: The dedup signature (src/core/PDFOptimizer.cpp:527-535) keys on /Subtype /Width /Height /ColorSpace /BitsPerComponent /Filter /DecodeParms plus a raw-bytes hash, but omits /SMask, /Mask (and /Type, /Intent, /Interpolate, /Matte). Two byte-identical image streams that differ only by carrying a soft/color-key mask therefore collide and are merged by ReferenceRewriter::repointAll, repointing the non-alpha image's referrers to the alpha object (or vice versa) and silently changing transparency. The trigger is profile-independent when both source streams are kept original (identical raw bytes), and reachable under MaxQuality-no-slider when both are re-encoded identically. AC-C2 requires alpha never be mishandled; the AC-C5 signature key list does not include the alpha keys.
expected: Streams only merge when nothing rendering-relevant differs: at minimum /SMask and /Mask (plus /Type and /Intent) must be part of the dedup signature.
suggested_direction: Add /SMask, /Mask, /Type, /Intent to the signature key set in the dedup loop (conservative: any differing key prevents the merge). Add a regression fixture with two identical images where one carries /SMask.
